clips.title: The story
paras: At Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew works to perfect his mountain spirits. He gathers ingredients from across western Dun Morogh and tests his brewing recipes.

In Dun Morogh, brewing is a craft dwarves take seriously. Rejold works from Brewnall Village, near the frozen lake of the Iceflow River. He keeps refining his blends, seeking rare hops, mountain minerals, and pristine ice water. He wants to brew stouts hearty enough to warm even the stoutest dwarven warriors.

Rejold seeks the right flavors for drinks such as Shimmer Stout. He sends travelers across Dun Morogh to gather ingredients, trades favors with the siege pilots of Steelgrill's Depot, and arranges deliveries to thirsty patrons. His work keeps hearty ale flowing along the cold, trogg-plagued roads of Dun Morogh.
